risks.risk: Item type mismatch: the photo looks like a bicycle/small bicycle rather than a full motorcycle; pricing depends heavily on correct category.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo showing the full vehicle including any engine (if present) and the model/registration/serial plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case category visible (bicycle/small bicycle) rather than a motorcycle.

risks.risk: Tires/chain/brakes may be worn or seized after long storage; seller says change tires and oil chain, but condition is not confirmed.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of: tire tread, chain (front and side), brake pads/rotors, and a short video of braking and gear shifting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing tires and basic service (not “perfect”).

risks.risk: “All parts original” and “no rust” can’t be verified from one wide shot; there may be swapped parts or hidden corrosion.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of frame joints, chainstay area, brake calipers/lever area, and any rust spots under the seat and near the wheels.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible non-original parts and/or minor corrosion.

proof_requests: Send a clear full-body photo from both sides showing whether there is an engine (if it’s a motorcycle) or it’s a bicycle.
Send close-ups: front tire tread, rear tire tread, chain condition, and brake pads/rotors.
Send a short video: start/roll test (or pedal test if bicycle), braking test, and gear shifting through all gears.
response.reason: With only one photo and no readable model/engine/serial details, the exact item category and condition (tires/chain/brakes/gears) can’t be verified remotely, so a safe price cannot be chosen.
